successCriteria.description: EmployeeRepository class exists at src/modules/employee/employee.repository.ts and implements IEmployeeRepository (all three methods: findById, findByEmail, findByDepartment are present with correct signatures)
EmployeeService class exists at src/modules/employee/employee.service.ts and implements IEmployeeService (both methods: getEmployeeById, getEmployeeByEmail are present with correct signatures)
EmployeeService constructor accepts IEmployeeRepository and delegates getEmployeeById → repository.findById, getEmployeeByEmail → repository.findByEmail
EmployeeRepository uses the shared pool from src/shared/db/connection.ts for all PostgreSQL queries
All SQL queries use snake_case column names and map results to the camelCase Employee interface fields
Barrel index at src/modules/employee/index.ts re-exports all five symbols: Employee, IEmployeeRepository, EmployeeRepository, IEmployeeService, EmployeeService
All three files pass tsc --noEmit with strict TypeScript configuration (no implicit any, strict null checks)

constraints: Must use the shared pool from src/shared/db/connection.ts — no other database connection or client may be created (GP-001, HARNESS constraint no-direct-db-outside-repository)
No use of `any` type — use `unknown` with type guards if needed (HARNESS constraint no-any)
outOfScope: Unit tests for employee.repository.ts and employee.service.ts — these are produced in sibling sub-phase 3
Audit module implementation (audit.service.ts, audit/index.ts) — these are produced in sibling sub-phase 2
Shared types update (src/shared/types/index.ts) — produced in sibling sub-phase 2

entityInvariants.invariant: Must implement IEmployeeRepository exactly — all three methods (findById, findByEmail, findByDepartment) must be present with signatures matching the interface. The class must be the default or named export usable as a constructor.

Must implement IEmployeeService exactly — both methods (getEmployeeById, getEmployeeByEmail) must be present with signatures matching the interface. Constructor must accept IEmployeeRepository. Methods must delegate to the injected repository, not contain business logic.

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Returns null when no row matches the given id — does not throw
Returns null when no row matches the given email — does not throw
Returns empty array when no employees match the department — does not throw

consistencyRequirements.requirement: EmployeeRepository must implement IEmployeeRepository from employee.repository.interface.ts — all method signatures must match exactly
EmployeeRepository query result mapping must produce objects matching the Employee interface shape (id, fullName, email, department, managerId, createdAt, updatedAt) with correct types
EmployeeRepository must import and use the exported `pool` from src/shared/db/connection.ts — no other pool or client creation
Barrel index at src/modules/employee/index.ts must follow the same re-export pattern as src/modules/uptime/index.ts: named re-exports using `export { Thing } from './thing.file'` syntax

integrationPoints.why: EmployeeRepository requires the PostgreSQL pool for all database queries
